concept.hr: Dvije diode provode naizmjence, pa obje poluperiode izlaze pozitivne
concept.en: Two diodes take turns, so both half-periods come out positive

summary.hr: Transformator sa srednjim odcjepom i dvije diode: u svakoj poluperiodi provodi jedna, a struja kroz trošilo uvijek teče u istom smjeru.
summary.en: A centre-tapped transformer and two diodes: in each half-period one of them conducts, and the current through the load always flows the same way.

what.hr: Aplet applet_gleichrichter_1.html (punovalni ispravljač, obje poluperiode odvojeno) i njegove slike 959, 960 i 961 (50ohm.de, hrvatski prijevod)
what.en: The applet applet_gleichrichter_1.html (the full-wave rectifier, both half-periods separately) and its figures 959, 960 and 961 (50ohm.de, Croatian translation)

credits.by: 50ohm.de-Autorenteam, AJW-Referat des DARC e.V. (figures: Dr. Matthias Jung, DL9MJ)

changes.hr: Prilagođen simdeck kitu, slike ponovno nacrtane kao SVG, tekst preveden na engleski, gumbi postali koraci i predlošci, dodani korak s obje poluperiode, pregled stanja dioda i objašnjenje
changes.en: Adapted to the simdeck kit, the figures redrawn as SVG, the text translated into English, the buttons turned into steps and presets, a step with both half-periods, a summary of the diodes' states and an explanation added
